Subject: Sizing call booking + prep checklist for Dedicated GPU pool

Hi Sophie — great conversation earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the right folks on the sizing call:

Recap (from discovery):
- Primary use case: real-time chat summarization + short-form generation (customer messages -> structured outputs).
- Target latency SLO: 95th %ile <= 200ms for 256-token responses; peak bursts expected during batch jobs.
- Expected steady-state qPS: ~12–18 req/s, peak bursts up to ~80 req/s for short windows.
- Model family: open Llama2-13B variant (we discussed quantized options).
- Data: 10M monthly input messages, retention constraints, and redaction requirements (we noted security team will follow up).

Next steps I suggest:
1) Schedule a 60-minute Dedicated capacity sizing call (throughput + latency deep dive) with your infra/security stakeholders present.
2) BlueStone to share a short sample workload CSV (timestamps, avg input tokens, avg output tokens, concurrency hints) — we attach a throughput_template.csv to make this easy.
3) We'll run a short pre-call checklist on our side (kernel/quantization options, pooling strategy, KV cache expectations) and bring performance profiles from similar customers.

Proposed time slots (PST):
- Thu May 27, 10:00–11:00 AM PT
- Fri May 28, 2:00–3:00 PM PT

If those don't work, send two slots that do and we'll prioritize the earlier one. I attached a short prep checklist (redwood_throughput_checklist.pdf) and the CSV template.

Thanks — Lauren
